Name: Peaceful Ant (Paintings of Peace and new Shop) (CP)
Author: ConfusedWolf
Description:
[size=4][b][i][u]Only works when the Hat Mouse is available[/u][/i][/b][/size][size=3]

After hearing that the fight between the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Setting#Ferngill_Republic]Ferngill Republic[/url] and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Gotoro_Empire]Gotoro Empire[/url] is still raging on, the King of Ant-iopia, Peaceful Ant, decided to sell his diverse selection of paintings, all of which themed around peace and friendship, in Pelican Town, right next to the the Hat Mouse.

It is said that his kingdom and the people of Mousica, the country where Hat Mouse originates, have had their fair share of wars in the past, but reconciled and are now on friendly terms.

But just like these very different folks were able to reconcile, the Ant King hopes that by selling his Peaceful Painless Paintings, the current war will also come to a close.

[b]Note[/b]: We are not going to add any real-life country-specific flags to this mod, only generic symbols of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peace]peace[/url].[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eFTLKWw542g]
[/url]
